title: Charmeleon Only Calms When Someone Loses
premise: Charmeleon constantly seeks opponents, and its Pokédex says winning is the only thing that calms it.
audiencePromise: See how fights excite Charmeleon, strong foes make it aggressive, and only victory calms it.
openLoop: What does its temper do before victory finally calms it?
payoff: Victory is its off switch: tough fights excite it, strong foes make it aggressive, and agitation can incinerate its surroundings.
engagementQuestion: Is it chasing calm, or chasing the next fight?

voice.instructions: Start with a sharp, uneasy edge. Build pressure with controlled intensity, then make the final question thoughtful and debatable.

scenes.headline: SOMEONE HAS TO LOSE
scenes.narration: Charmeleon only calms when someone else loses.
scenes.caption: CALM HAS ONE CONDITION

scenes.headline: IT CONSTANTLY SEEKS FIGHTS
scenes.narration: Its hotheaded nature keeps it constantly seeking opponents to fight.
scenes.caption: HOTHEADED AND LOOKING FOR OPPONENTS

scenes.headline: TOUGH FIGHTS EXCITE IT
scenes.narration: A tough fight can excite it into bluish-white flames.
scenes.caption: EXCITEMENT CAN CHANGE THE FLAME

scenes.headline: STRONG FOES MAKE IT WORSE
scenes.narration: Strong foes do not soothe it. They turn it aggressive.
scenes.caption: A BIGGER CHALLENGE RAISES THE HEAT

scenes.headline: CALM COMES AFTER THE DAMAGE
scenes.narration: Winning calms it, but agitation can incinerate its surroundings.
scenes.caption: VICTORY IS THE OFF SWITCH

scenes.headline: CURE OR COMPULSION?
scenes.narration: Is it chasing calm, or chasing the next fight?
scenes.caption: ONLY A WIN BRINGS CALM
